fsm_states_hba_global.name: H:Init
fsm_states_hba_global.description: Resets state variables; clears GHC.AE / GHC.IE / IS; entered on GHC.HR=1 or power-up.

fsm_states_hba_global.name: Ccc:GenIntr
fsm_states_hba_global.description: Generate a system interrupt for CCC.

fsm_states_port.name: P:NotRunning
fsm_states_port.description: PxCMD.ST=0; port DMA engine idle; PxCMD.CR=0.

fsm_states_port.name: P:FetchCmd
fsm_states_port.description: Reads Command Header from system memory.

fsm_states_port.name: P:FetchCFIS
fsm_states_port.description: Reads Command FIS (CFIS) from the Command Table at CTBA.

fsm_states_port.name: P:DataXmit
fsm_states_port.description: Streams Data FIS payload to device (write).

fsm_states_port.name: P:DataRecv
fsm_states_port.description: Sinks Data FIS payload from device (read).

fsm_states_port.name: P:DMASetup
fsm_states_port.description: Processes DMA Setup FIS; updates DSFIS.

fsm_states_port.name: P:PIOSetup
fsm_states_port.description: Processes PIO Setup FIS; updates PSFIS.

fsm_states_port.name: P:D2HRecv
fsm_states_port.description: Processes D2H Register FIS; updates RFIS + PxTFD + PxSIG.

fsm_states_port.name: P:SDBRecv

fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.name: Await_COMINIT
fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.description: Host PHY listens for COMINIT response.

fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.name: Await_COMWAKE
fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.description: Host PHY listens for COMWAKE response.

fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.name: ALIGN_lock
fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.description: PHY achieves bit + word lock via ALIGN primitives.

fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.name: Speed_Negotiate
fsm_states_oob_link_initialization.description: Host tries highest supported speed; falls back.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: Set Device Bits FIS with I=1

fsm_hints.trigger: Power-up / reset -> OOB -> SPEED_NEGOTIATION -> DWORD_SYNC -> READY. A connection request drives OPEN_REQUEST -> ARBITRATING -> CONNECTED on OPEN_ACCEPT.
fsm_hints.rule: Frames flow only inside an open connection; RRDY credit must be granted before an SSP frame is sent; each SSP frame is ACK/NAKed.
fsm_hints.abort: OPEN_REJECT denies a request; BREAK aborts a stalled connection; HARD_RESET resets the phy.

anti_deadlock_rule: Arbitration uses the arbitration wait time (AWT) carried in the OPEN address frame to resolve contention fairly across the SAS domain; expander pathway recovery and BREAK resolve blocked or deadlocked routing so a connection request cannot stall indefinitely.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-up / reset (or HARD_RESET) the phy runs OOB (COMINIT/COMSAS/COMWAKE), then the Speed Negotiation Window to select the link rate, then achieves dword synchronization, and becomes ready to open or accept connections.

default_ready_state_recommendation.idle: Exchange idle / ALIGN dwords to keep dword synchronization between connections.
default_ready_state_recommendation.connection: Open a connection (OPEN address frame) before sending SSP/STP/SMP frames; grant RRDY credit before accepting frames.

configurations.name: Narrow port
configurations.description: A port with a single phy.

configurations.name: Wide port
configurations.description: A port with multiple phys sharing the same SAS address; a wide link connects two wide ports.

configurations.name: Direct-attach
configurations.description: Initiator port connected point-to-point to a target port (no expander).

configurations.name: Expander topology
configurations.description: Edge and fanout expanders route connections to build a large SAS domain.

timing_dependency_rule: Before any frame flows the phy must complete OOB + speed negotiation + dword synchronization, and a connection must be open. Rate matching (ALIGN insertion) couples a slower connection rate to a faster physical link rate so the receiver is not overrun.

fsm_states_phy.name: OOB
fsm_states_phy.description: Out-of-band signaling: COMINIT/COMRESET, COMSAS, COMWAKE detect attachment and distinguish SAS from SATA.

fsm_states_phy.name: SPEED_NEGOTIATION
fsm_states_phy.description: The Speed Negotiation Window (SNW) negotiates the highest common link rate.

fsm_states_phy.name: DWORD_SYNC
fsm_states_phy.description: The phy achieves dword synchronization on the encoded stream (ALIGN / idle dwords).

fsm_states_phy.name: READY
fsm_states_phy.description: The phy is synchronized and ready to open or accept connections.

fsm_states_connection.name: IDLE
fsm_states_connection.description: No connection; the phy exchanges idle dwords.

fsm_states_connection.name: OPEN_REQUEST
fsm_states_connection.description: A port transmits an OPEN address frame (source/destination SAS address, rate, protocol, arbitration wait time).

fsm_states_connection.name: ARBITRATING
fsm_states_connection.description: Expanders route the OPEN frame and emit AIP while arbitration resolves contention.

fsm_states_connection.name: CONNECTED
fsm_states_connection.description: OPEN_ACCEPT received; a dedicated full-duplex connection carries SSP/STP/SMP frames with RRDY/ACK/NAK flow control.

fsm_states_connection.name: CLOSING
fsm_states_connection.description: CLOSE (or DONE then CLOSE) tears down the connection; BREAK aborts it.
